text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse was wrapped in an 
extraordinary wave of feverish excitement 
on this day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On one side, an Umamusume who dealt a 
defeat to the Eternal Big Three. On the 
other, an Umamusume hailed as a legend, 
thought never to return.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse: Turf, 2,400 meters, the 
Classic distance. The only GⅠ with the 
exact same conditions as the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the Japan Cup, the two's Derby begins.
